newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran considering entry into crude paper markets.
newsitem.headline: Iran considering entry into crude paper markets.

text.p: A senior official at the National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) was reported on Thursday as saying the company could become involved in forward crude markets.

"We might enter into the paper market of oil on condition that all different aspects of it are taken under consideration and the competent authorities accept its risks and costs," Hojattolah Ghanimifard, NIOC's head of international affairs, told the Iran daily newspaper.
"This could be a basis guaranteeing our solid and consistent presence on the world oil market," the official told Iran.
Ghanimifard has day to day responsibility over Iran's 2.6 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude exports.
NIOC, through an overseas subsidiary, used London's IPE oil futures exchange in 1994 though the scale of its activity on the futures market was said to have been limited.
